allot.text: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'the Debenture AllotmentCommittee of the Company in its meeting held today, approved and allotted 30,000 7.49% Listed, Unsecured, Redeemable, Non-Cumulative, Taxable, Non-Convertible Bonds in the nature of Debentures (NCDs) of face value of Rs.1,00,000/-(Rupees One Lakh only) each, aggregating to Rs.300 crore                                (Rupees Three Hundred Crore only) on private placement basis '.
